answer: Anchor identity to per-epoch hardware entropy: every attestation must embed a fresh puzzle solved on a device-bound keystore whose rate limit cannot be shared across keys, so a reef of parallel accounts exhausts one box's puzzle budget and later clones stall. Make admission timber-age dependent: the difficulty of the k-th identity from one funding source grows quadratically, like rings hardening a trunk, so mass minting pays super-linearly per head. Correlated faults slash the whole tundra cluster at once, making pooled farming ruinous.
